summary: A checkout deploy removed payment-intent state validation, causing an 8.4% 5xx rate on POST /api/checkout/pay. Vigil identified the culprit commit and posted an on-call brief within a minute of the alert; the incident was resolved by rolling back the deploy.

timeline.event: HighErrorRate alert fired for checkout (5xx above 8% for 5 minutes).
Vigil brief posted: commit 71cd87314d flagged as likely culprit (confidence 0.86) with rollback runbook.
Incident marked resolved after the checkout deploy was rolled back.

root_cause: Commit 71cd87314d refactored confirm_payment and removed the IntentState.REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION check, relying on middleware validation that was not enabled in this deploy. Unvalidated intents reached the payment gateway and failed with 'payment intent state invalid'.
contributing_factors: The middleware validation the refactor depended on was tracked in a separate change that had not shipped.
No integration test covered confirming a payment intent in a non-confirmable state.
impact: Checkout errored for the duration of the incident at roughly 8% of requests against a 1,200 requests/minute baseline; affected purchase attempts saw HTTP 500s.
resolution: Rolled back the checkout deploy containing 71cd87314d; error rate returned to baseline. The refactor will re-land together with the middleware validation change.
went_well: Culprit commit identified automatically within one minute of the alert.
Runbook rollback procedure was current and worked as written.
went_poorly: A state-validation removal shipped without its companion middleware change.
Test coverage did not exercise invalid intent states.

action_items.description: Add integration test: confirm_payment rejects intents not in REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION.
Gate refactors that move validation across layers behind a feature flag.
Alert on checkout 5xx at 2% (earlier than the 8% page) for faster detection.
